summary: Artifact box: it copies an ordinary item, grows to hold a creature, and can grow that creature a clone.
text: Close this 2-foot box around an ordinary (nonmagical) item and a perfect duplicate appears beside it. Magic actions let it grow big enough to hold a Medium creature, or shrink back. With a creature inside and 100 GP of diamond dust consumed, it casts Clone; the creature then steps out and the box locks for 120 days, and the finished clone needs no vessel. Left without a clone inside, 999 years in a Feywild bog destroys it. (The clone plays out in the story; the game has no Clone spell to wake it.)
